description.zh: 工作流ID。如何获取工作流ID，请参见[ListPipelines](~~438051~~)。
description.en: The pipeline ID. You can call [ListPipelines](~~438051~~) to obtain the ID of the pipeline.

descriptions.zh: 如果指定的工作流作为共享工作流被用户订阅、或者作为子工作流被其它工作流引用，则不允许删除。
descriptions.en: If the specified pipeline is subscribed by users as a shared pipeline or referenced by other pipelines as a sub-pipeline, the pipeline cannot be deleted.
